key_impacts: More than one million people were displaced.
At least five million people were affected across Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, India, Thailand, Seychelles, and Myanmar.
Many hospitals and health centres were destroyed or damaged, with some health workers among the victims.
Water supplies and sanitation systems were damaged or contaminated in some areas.
